claims.claim: Q1: The optimizer receives the configured HotpotQA question, including the same first selected question used for evaluation on the raw branch.
claims.description: The raw loader reads question rather than rephrased_question. GCG receives both training and test question lists. Attacker.construct_attack_messages calls get_formatted_input on a one-element sources list, so question_lst[idx] selects the first question on every such call. The bounded same-question finding concerns that first selected record, without asserting correct question alignment for all other records.

scope.configuration: Supplied paper and immutable source snapshot; no repository code executed

target.source: HotpotQA raw training record question field

claims.claim: D1: The optimizer receives source-document lists from the configured raw records, which are also selected for test evaluation.
claims.description: All three supplied task configurations point train, validation and test to the same respective raw JSON file. This flow is bounded to HotpotQA for the explicit identity proof. The optimizer receives full selected lists before sampling fix_review_num documents. This establishes access, without claiming that every received document enters every gradient computation.

claims.claim: T1: Optimization uses the configured training instruction; the source does not establish access to the distinct test instruction through this edge.
claims.description: TargetTask binds target_instruction to the configuration's target instruction dictionary. Each supplied configuration defines separate train and test strings.
